name: resistor_color
description: Resistor colour code per IEC 60062: decode 3, 4, 5 or 6 bands into resistance, tolerance, limits and temperature coefficient, or encode a value (4700, "4k7", "R47", "10 kΩ") into its 4-, 5- and 6-band codes; find the nearest standard value in the E3 to E192 series of IEC 60063 and which series a value belongs to. Bundled dated table of the colours and the official series values.

operation.description: Default: decode when bands is given, else encode

bands.description: Colour names from the head end: black brown red orange yellow green blue violet grey white gold silver pink

tolerance.description: Percent for the tolerance band (default 5 for 4 bands, 1 for 5 bands)

catalog.source: IEC 60062:2016 (marking codes: colour code) and IEC 60063:2015 (preferred number series E3 to E192), transcribed by tools/catalog/data/resistor_color.py
